output.title: pac package deploy hangs indefinitely deploying X++/FnO external package to Unified Developer Experience (UDE) environment
steps_to_reproduce: Provision a UDE-linked F&O environment via Power Platform Admin Center (no LCS project).

Build an X++ model with custom table/field extensions in Visual Studio 2022 (Unified Developer Experience tooling). Confirm the model deploys successfully via **Extensions → Dynamics 365 → Deploy → Deploy Models to Online Environment** in Visual Studio (this path works correctly and is not affected by this bug).

Create a Dataverse 'Package Deployer' project (`pac package init`) and add the X++ deployable package as an external package: `pac package add-external-package --package-type xpp --path <deployable-package.zip>`.
Build the project (`dotnet build`) to produce the package DLL and `PkgAssets/ImportConfig.xml`.

Ensure the referenced zip is a correctly-formed Power Platform Unified Package (containing `fnomoduledefinition.json` at the root plus the compiled model folder) — produced via the official Azure Pipelines `XppCreatePackage@3` task with `CreateCloudPackage: true`. (A package missing this structure fails fast and cleanly with a different, expected error —
output.actual_result: The deployment hangs indefinitely. The process never completes, never errors, and never times out. The main thread blocks forever on an internal `ManualResetEventSlim.Wait()` inside `pac`'s own deployment code, waiting for a signal that is never sent. All other threads in the process are completely idle — there is no background work in progress anywhere.

output.title: pac env fetch inconsistent output
steps_to_reproduce: Create an XML file (environment-variables.xml) with the following FetchXML query:
```xml
<fetch version='1.0' output-format='xml-platform' mapping='logical' distinct='true'>
<entity name='environmentvariabledefinition'>
<attribute name='schemaname' />
<attribute name='defaultvalue' />
<link-entity name='environmentvariablevalue' from='environmentvariabledefinitionid' to='environmentvariabledefinitionid' link-type='outer' alias='env'>
<attribute name='value' />
</link-entity>
</entity>
</fetch>
Execute the `fetch` command while referencing the XML file created in step 1: `pac env fetch --xmlFile environment-variables.xml`
Re-execute the command from step 2.
Note the columns and values that were output.
output.expected_result: Results returned should respect the FetchXML query specified (column order and sorting).
output.actual_result:
Sometimes, the columns / values are output as:
```
schemaname                                             defaultvalue
msdyn_SLAWebClientDeprecationAcknowledge               00
msdyn_ShouldShowPeekButton                             no
msdyn_lineofbusinessfiltertemplatefeatureuserexpansion 00000000-00000000-00000000-00000000
msdyn_lineofbusinessfiltertemplatefeature              00000000-00000000-00000000-00000000
```
